questions.question: If in a code language, BULB is written as 71 and TUBE is written as 60, then how will FAN be written in the same language?
questions.solution:
According to the English alphabet series and its positional value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1196a07d03c9f02e7bec22cfc36a195fd3a58e076da25a1e2a394b79aea80ec7.png] 

The logic follows here is:

Sum of reverse positional values.

B is opposite to Y = 25

U is opposite to F = 6

L is opposite to O = 15

BULB = (25 + 6 + 15 + 25) = 71

And;

T is opposite to G = 7

U is opposite to F = 6

B is opposite to Y = 25

E is opposite to V = 22

TUBE = (7 + 6 + 25 + 22) = 60 

Similarly, 

F is opposite to U = 21

A is opposite yo Z = 26

N is opposite to M = 13

FAN = (21 + 26 + 13) = 60

Hence,** "60" **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the number that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

83 : 121 :: 12 : ?
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:

(Sum of digit of fist number)² = Second Number

(8 + 3)² = 11² = 121

Similarly,

(1 + 2)² = 3² = 9

Hence,** "9"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements: **

1. All boats are cats.

2. All cats are bats.

3. All bats are rabbits.

**Conclusions: **

I. All cats are rabbits.

II. All bats are boats.

III. All boats are rabbits.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follow:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9be4755d393d73cce6a8d6269fbd68b643d4ff898f19c3ba76b06848f208d18a.png] 

Conclusions: 

I. All cats are rabbits → True (As all cats are bats and all bats are rabbits)

II. All bats are boats → False (This is possibility but not definite)

III. All boats are rabbits → True (As all boats are cats, all cats are bats, and all bats are rabbits)

Hence, **Only conclusions I and III follow.**

questions.question: If in a code language, BOX is written as 31425 and FUN is written as 72015, then how will LION be written in the same language?
questions.solution:
According to the English alphabet series and its positional value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1196a07d03c9f02e7bec22cfc36a195fd3a58e076da25a1e2a394b79aea80ec7.png] 

The logic follows here is:

Each consonant's place value is increased by 1 and vowels is decreased by 1.

B = 2 (2 + 1 = 3)

O = 15 (15 - 1 = 14)

X = 24 (25 + 1 = 26)

BOX = 31426

And;

F = 6 (6 + 1 = 7)

U = 21 (21 - 1 = 20)

N = 14 (14 + 1 = 15)

FUN = 72015

Similarly,

L = 12 (12 + 1 = 13)

I = 9 (9 - 1 = 8)

O = 15 (15 - 1 = 14)

N = 14 (14 + 1 = 15)

LION = 1381415

Hence,** "1381415"** is the correct answer.

6 ÷ 2 × 3

21 × 3 + 7

63 + 7 = 70

Hence,** "70"** is the correct answer.
